# 15: 并行初始化、当次鉴权与非阻塞调度

**What to build:** 每 CLI 并行预取已配置 provider，首次请求有限等待，后续查询不挡执行；凭据只用于当次操作，旧实例结果不再产生效果。

**Delivers:** P37, P40, P53

**Blocked by:** 12: DeepSeek 余额成功 TTL 与在途合并；13: Codex 响应 headers 与独立额度窗口

**Status:** ready-for-agent

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 认证可读时一次并行预取已配置 DeepSeek/Codex，缺源不查，不依赖当前模型；首模型请求前成功/失败/超时有限收口，允许先输入且失败不阻断模型。
- [ ] 同 CLI 子共用缓存/初始化，独立 CLI 各自独立；切模型/Session/tree/查看不全量预取或销毁有效缓存。
- [ ] 每次操作读取并固定当次已生效凭据及必要地址，替换不改在途操作；凭据/OAuth/原生接入失败只影响对应查询，不跨凭据借用、不填零。
- [ ] 运行期悬挂网络不阻下一模型请求、工具、idle 或退出；通知时重读当前目标，销毁后迟到结果不反馈/重绘/进入新实例，不新增主动 HTTP 取消或退出排空。
- [ ] 合成秘密哨兵验证正确目标/鉴权、当次固定和局部失败；错误、日志、模型内容、文件与证据不含秘密，真实秘密不进入对话。
- [ ] 通过公共绑定、S2、mock 网络及隔离实际 OMP 请求顺序验证并行/首请求门槛/非阻塞/销毁；使用网络悬挂场景而非仅 Promise 不抛断言。
- [ ] 通过批准的生产公共 seam 观察行为，预期来自合同/规格、独立字面值或手算，不以被测实现重算；永久网络 tests 使用 mock。
- [ ] 使用隔离安装/配置/工作/Session/数据根，不操作正式 OMP；承接异步失败并保留够用脱敏证据，完成本票自动检查及材料准备，不因计划人工验收暂停可执行工作。

## Verification responsibility

本票负责所列 Delivers 的自动 coverage 与适用宿主贯通/证据准备；P58/P52 按本票具名责任执行。合同采用 Rapid iteration：H1/H2 及允许的条件性 H3 按原 Coverage 交用户确认，未确认不记通过；不改变承诺或免除实现/永久 tests。

tdd_result.description: Implement parallel provider prefetch and per-operation auth

data.status: implementation + assigned automated checks complete; no H1/H2 items owned by this ticket, no H3 transfer triggered

behavior_delivered.parallel_startup_prefetch: `runtime.initialize` runs `await Promise.all([balance.prefetch(), quota.startup()])` after the baseline/estimate file loads: the configured DeepSeek balance and the Codex allowance are asked at the same instant (settle bounded by the slower, not the sum), before the first model request, independent of the session's model.
behavior_delivered.missing_source_not_queried: The balance prefetch resolves the host's access and, when no usable credential is readable, issues no request AND states no failure (a source the host cannot authenticate is not configured here → not an attempt). A settled request's check keeps the earlier contract: a missing credential there is that query's own failure. Codex account startup behaviour left as ticket 13 shipped it (peer-confirmed).
behavior_delivered.first_request_gate: Unchanged framework path (`behaviors/binding.ts` + `behaviors/lifecycle.ts`: init once at the owner session node, run initiation waits for the pending init, a rejection is reported not rethrown), now driven by the two prefetches and proven for model-cost at S1/S2/S5.
behavior_delivered.per_operation_credentials: Access is read at each operation and fixed into that request (address + credential); a replacement during an in-flight query does not rewrite it and the next operation uses the new one; no provider borrows another's credential.
behavior_delivered.non_blocking_and_disposal: One in-flight query per instance (`beginQuery` join replaces the old `querying` flag, so the prefetch and settled requests merge both ways); no cancellation signal is ever passed; after disposal, late answers write neither a reading nor a window and notify nobody; the run exits with a query still out.
behavior_delivered.secret_sentinel: Synthetic sentinel verified present only in its own provider's authorized request and absent from results/failure details, feedback, notices, diagnostics, storage files, stderr, session JSONL, serialized model requests and widget frames.

production: extensions/model-cost/shared-logic/provider-balance.ts (new `prefetch()`; trigger-specific missing-source rule; `beginQuery` join; head doc)
extensions/model-cost/GLOSSARY.md (Provider balance reading entry: CLI's one startup prefetch, 缺源不查, TTL still checked only by that provider's settled requests)
tests: tests/model-cost/provider-balance.test.ts (P38 suite migrated same-ticket: prefetch kept apart in `bound.prefetched`, case counters/notifications start after it, TTL anchored on the prefetch's instant)

tests/model-cost/codex-quota.test.ts (P39 suite migrated same-ticket: access answers only the account API's provider; `resolved` expectation now states both asks; ticket 13's `no-access` case unchanged)
tests/harness-dock/model-cost-balance.test.ts (S5, 6 cases: reading+order, gate via held answer, refusal, hanging query during the next exchange, exit with a query out, sentinel)
files.evidence: .scratch/model-cost-migration/assets/15-provider-init-auth-lifecycle-evidence-2026-10-13.md (per-criterion support, commands+results, fault injections, desensitized S5 observations, P58/P52 sections, limits)

criteria_evidence.AC1 parallel + missing source + finite s: S2: both requests in flight before either answers (sequential await leaves the second unissued); run initiation not settled while either is out then settles on success/failure/timeout without rejecting; zero request and empty balance result for an unauthenticated or address-only source; prefetch occurs at the owner session node before any Turn fact (address = provider's own).
criteria_evidence.AC2 sharing/independence/no re-prefetch: S2: subagent session + its run initiation ask nothing again; an ordinary session switch (transferred+start+session_facts) asks nothing again and keeps the prefetched reading; two runtimes = two CLIs, two requests each, each with its own host credential. Framework's one-instance/no-destroy rule: tests/framework/implementation-lifecycle.test.ts (P56).
criteria_evidence.AC3 per-operation credential, local fail: S2: credential replaced while the query is out → in-flight header keeps the fixed one, next operation uses the replacement; address-only → no request, no borrowing of the other provider's credential; failures are classified facts (no-access/unreachable/unreadable/misconfigured), never a zero reading.
criteria_evidence.AC4 non-blocking + disposal: S2: a never-answering refresh holds neither the next run initiation nor a later settled request (which joins it, 2 requests total; no `signal` in any outbound options). S5: second real exchange issued and completed while the balance query was unanswered (arrivals = balance,model,balance,model), then session.stop() with the query still out → exit 0, timedOut false; after session_end(disposed) both late answers land nowhere (balance()/quota() empty, 0 notifications). 'Re-read the current target on notify' is inherited widget/display behaviour (existing display + dock modes suites).
criteria_evidence.AC5 secret sentinel: S2 (both failure paths, incl. a rejecting error whose message carries the sentinel) and S5 (real run: stderr, session JSONL, captured model request bodies, widget frames, storage files) — sentinel only in its own provider's request header, failures still visible as sanitized details; no real credential was ever read.
criteria_evidence.AC6 public binding/S2/mock + isolated OM: held promises + production runtime + framework public binding (S2) and a real child process + real local capture endpoint (S5): ordering, gate (model request withheld in a 3s window while the answer is held, released after), hanging query, exit and disposal are all observations of what did/did not happen, not 'the promise did not throw'.
criteria_evidence.AC7 approved seams, independent expectat: Observations at production read-only results/change subscription/outbound request records/operator channels/files (S2) and the real operator entrance (S5); literals are the spec's own 5000/10000ms budgets, 30000ms TTL, recorded URLs and documented document shapes; permanent tests use injected mocks only.
criteria_evidence.AC8 isolation + evidence: S5 uses the dock's isolated baseline install + createRunRoot (agent state/session/work/capture/user-home inside it) with fixture credentials only; S2 uses mkdtemp roots; async failures are absorbed by each module; the evidence doc holds the desensitized record. No official OMP was touched.
criteria_evidence.P58: No framework public interface changed (prefetch is extension-internal shared logic); affected callers were the two S2 suites' helpers/assertions, migrated in this ticket; connect-bot/codebase-tools untouched and green (connect-bot 142 pass/2 known-red real-panel).
criteria_evidence.P52: No persistence change: the reading lives in process memory; consumption.json / codex-usage-estimate.json schema, shape and version untouched.

commands.result: 56 pass / 2 fail (the two pre-existing baseline.test.ts anchor drifts only)
769 pass / 4 fail, 773 tests, 85 files, ~236s — the same 4 pre-existing failures (2 baseline anchor, 2 connect-bot panel)

fault_injections_verified_then_restored: fire-and-forget prefetch (`void Promise.all`) → S2 2 fail + S5 gate case fail (model arrival inside the withheld window)
prefetch removed → 17 of 24 S2 cases fail
missing-source rule made uniform (`no-access` always) → S2 2 fail
late-reading disposal guard removed → S2 1 fail
in-flight join removed → 6 fail across the two S2 files
failure detail made to carry the credential → S2 2 fail (sentinel + failure-semantics cases)
all injections reverted; typecheck + tests/model-cost + dock balance re-run green, grep confirms no residue
unverified_or_limited: Real provider reading quality (real DeepSeek balance / Codex windows) is P38/P39's H2, not this ticket: the S5 runs prove scheduling, gate, non-blocking and credential boundaries on a real host, not real service acceptance.

The S5 gate case uses one real 3s window (a real child process's progress is real time) and then releases the same request to show the run was in that wait; documented as the dock's integration exception.

Deliberate asymmetry: the balance prefetch skips an unauthenticated source silently while the Codex account startup (ticket 13's shipped contract, peer-confirmed) states `no-access`; both satisfy 缺源不查 (zero outbound). Reason: the widget's balance line is drawn in every non-hidden mode, so recording a failure for an untouched provider would add a line to unrelated modes.
Host `ProviderAccess.resolve` latency itself is not separately bounded; the settle bound is the HTTP module's per-request budget (5000ms balance / 10000ms account).
2 dock baseline anchor failures and 2 connect-bot real-panel failures are pre-existing (checkout at 579da1d vs recorded anchor 9348320) and documented in ticket 12's evidence.
H3 conditional human transfer: not triggered — the isolated real-host scripts passed on the first run with no repetition or over-cost; no criteria left for human confirmation by this ticket.
